source: SHIPPED 2026-09-28 RELEASE STAMPS ONLY (releases/desktop-flash/<stamp>/*.img, read read-only via debugfs / VNDRBOOT+cpio for vendor_kernel_boot.img). Every artifacts[] row is evidence_kind='stamp-image'; no build-recipe or build-tree artifact is tier-bearing.
build_tree_corroboration_policy: Build-tree artifacts (out/target/product/<dev>/) are recorded only in devices[].build_tree_corroboration with tier_contribution=false; they are never in artifacts[] and never set a tier.

honesty.gate_minus1: IN-PROCESS (local governance YAML only); no aegis-verifier / ask_guardian / gate_enforcer / Guardian HTTP call was attempted or made
honesty.gate5: IN-PROCESS self-critique, score 88/100 (>= Gate 5 threshold 70); the MCP ultimate_critique endpoint is unavailable in this environment so no external score is invented or claimed
honesty.reachability_caveat: Tier C means the shipped artifact can become active; no on-device badge was run.

derivation.method: debugfs read-only against the shipped partition images; image sha256 from the stamp's own SHA256SUMS; first-stage vendor modules read from the vendor_kernel_boot.img vendor ramdisk (VNDRBOOT v4 + legacy-LZ4 + newc cpio)

tier_rules.kernel_module: present in shipped modules.load and not 'blocklist'-ed -> C; present and blocked -> B; absent -> A
tier_rules.userspace_service: shipped service binary/lib -> C; residual config/overlay only -> B; absent -> A

derivation.stamp_resolution: releases/desktop-flash/<dev>-latest (all 13 including tokay-latest, which the 2026-09-28 re-stamp created)

rebind.basis: APPROVED R2 derivation engine, re-run against the 2026-09-28 stamps; every tier rule unchanged except the single radio-free detection fix below

derivation_fixes.r2_test: radio-free iff the substring 'no_radio' appears in the manifest provenance filename (and no rild)
derivation_fixes.rebind_test: radio-free iff the shipped vendor manifest declares 0 'android.hardware.radio' HALs (and no rild in /bin/hw) — measured from the bytes
derivation_fixes.why: the 2026-09-28 rebuild swapped the manifest to vintf/vendor_manifest_no_bt_*.xml, documented in-file as the no_radio manifest minus the four Bluetooth HAL declarations; the filename substring test therefore reported a false failure on a manifest with 0 radio HALs and no rild.
derivation_fixes.direction: STRENGTHEN — the new test inspects the shipped artifact rather than a filename token; it is not a relaxation.  Both readings are preserved so the Architect can adjudicate.
derivation_fixes.evidence: per-device detail field records android.hardware.radio decls, rild presence and the provenance filename

gen6_gen7_audited_absence.reason: No shipped stamp exists for Gen 6/Gen 7; out of program scope (DEC-PORT-GEN8910-001 section 7).
